stem: A quarantine boundary is accidentally crossed. What should Technician I do?
choices: Ignore it if no symptom appears immediately
Move more material to make the workflow consistent
Follow the breach/containment procedure and document the event rather than silently continuing
rationale: Follow the breach/containment procedure and document the event rather than silently continuing. This preserves the Course 005 identity, crop-care, scouting, biosecurity, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
